profile_text.body:
Phrase is an enterprise localization and translation platform founded in 2012 and accessible at phrase.com. The company describes itself as an AI-powered language intelligence platform designed to help organizations automate multilingual content workflows, connect to a broad range of translation engines and large language models, and scale localization across global markets. Its architecture is headless and API-first, and the company states it supports both human-to-system and agent-to-agent interaction, allowing technical teams and agentic workflows to orchestrate content across an organization's technology stack.

The core product, tracked on this site as Phrase (Memsource), is an enterprise translation management system with machine translation capabilities, EU hosting, and GDPR compliance. Key platform features described on the company's site include intelligent engine orchestration, tools called Auto Adapt and Quality Estimation for output consistency, unified translation memories and terminology management, budget controls, and automated quality gates. The platform also references a Verified Solutions Programme and a Forward Deployed Engineers function for custom integrations. The company states that MCP server support is available, enabling connection to AI assistants, writing tools, and business applications that teams already use.

No litigation, SEC filings, or patent records are held for Phrase in this site's current data.
